3417 Plains Street
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$295,000, 4 bed, 2.50 bath, 1,999 SF, MLS# 556962

This beautiful home is move in ready! With 4BR/2.5 BA, and almost 2000 sq. ft., this home has plenty of room for your growing family. The family room is roomy, and plenty big enough for a sectional and family fun!
The master is very large with an ensuite bathroom with a walk in shower, garden tub, two vanities, and spacious walk in closets! The minor bedrooms are a good size, with a hall bath in between. One of the bedrooms can be used as a flex room such as an office, extra den, or etc. Part of the large patio has been screened in, and is perfect for dining outdoors. The beautiful kitchen has a walk in pantry and plenty of cabinet and counter space for preparing family meals. Call your favorite realtor today to see this wonderful home!

2 full bath, 1 half bath
